steps: Confirm your home is served by a participating Oregon utility (PGE, Pacific Power, NW Natural, Cascade Natural Gas, or Avista).
Find an Energy Trust trade ally contractor on the official site.
Have the qualifying heat pump or ductless heat pump installed by that contractor.
Receive your cash incentive (up to $1,000 for a heat pump, up to $800 for ductless); Energy Trust does not publish the exact payout timeline.
timing: Cash incentive after trade-ally installation; Energy Trust does not publish an exact payout timeline.
